title: The 1-Hour Funnel Audit: The lead flow playbook nobody prints
caption:
The lead flow playbook nobody prints

This is what worked. Steal the system:
1️⃣ Count real leads — Not impressions. How many humans raised a hand this week?
2️⃣ Find the biggest drop — Ads to page, page to form, form to reply. One of them is bleeding.
3️⃣ Fix that leak alone — One change, isolated. Ten at once teaches you nothing.
4️⃣ Re-measure in 7 days — Same number, same place. Direction beats anecdotes.

Try it and tell me what happens.
